messages:
Faye Lim: Hi everyone! Im Faye, starting today as a Product Analytics engineer. Seattle-based, terrible at puns, great at chess, and currently on a mission to keep my apartment succulents alive. Excited to join Redwood :wave:
Jordan (People Ops): Welcome Faye!! :tada: We'll send the onboarding calendar and swag form. Quick Q badge pickup: will you be in SF in the next month or need us to mail one?
Faye Lim: Thanks Jordan! Ill be in SF for a week in three weeks, so mailing is fine until then. Shirt S, and I love stickers.
Avery Park: Welcome Faye :smile: Chess club meets after work sometimes in #random-chess. No pressure to join but it's low-key. Also, if youre into succulents, bring pics we do a plant brag thread.
Samir Gupta: Hey Faye! If you want an intro to our analytics dashboard, happy to run a 15-min tour. Also FYI Thursday lunch is board games this week we play rapid chess sometimes :chess_pawn:
Faye Lim: Ooh rapid chess sounds perfect. I'd love a quick dashboard tour, Samir. Also I will absolutely spam the plant channel with photos.
Jordan (People Ops): Got it, Faye. Mailing address DM'd. Added you to #random-chess and #plants. Badge handoff scheduled for your SF visit with office admin.
welcome-bot: :confetti_ball: Faye has been granted access to #analytics-oncall, #product-metrics, #random-chess, #plants. Welcome kit queued: 1x tee, 1x sticker pack, 1x enamel pin.
Avery Park: Also FYI our unofficial new-hires tradition is a 3-question icebreaker in #new-hires: (1) snack of choice, (2) guilty pleasure podcast, (3) favorite board game. No pressure but feel free to share!
Faye Lim: OK here we go: (1) dark chocolate, (2) mystery true-crime podcast, (3) Carcassonne. Looking forward to meeting folks :grinning:
